verdict.rationale: First-party docs show 1Password stores one-time passwords for logins and supports securely sharing logins. A hands-on community report confirms company-wide shared vaults organized by department and security level, which implies vault-scoped access. No first-party evidence documents shared/team vaults or per-member permission controls for human users; the vault access-control doc covers service accounts only. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of shared team vaults or collections, documented per-member/group vault permission settings, explicit confirmation that TOTP codes are available to members of shared vaults.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control

citations.quote: Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website.
Securely share logins, secrets, credit cards, Wi-Fi codes and other sensitive data with automatic expirations.
Uses 1Password professionally with company-wide shared vaults by department and security level.
